name: Early Training Evaluation Benchmarks for SLMs
description: Evaluate Small Language Models (SLMs) during early training stages on scientific knowledge acquisition, reasoning, and sensitivity to knowledge-intensive tasks.

cr:input.name: competition_dataset
cr:input.description: Participants receive tokenized datasets (English-only) with a vocabulary size of 65,000 tokens and reformulated prompts for benchmarks like MMLU-var, ARC-Easy, and SciQ. Example: 'Question: Find the degree for the given field extension Q(sqrt(2), sqrt(3), sqrt(18)) over Q. Choices: A. 0, B. 4, C. 2, D. 6.'
cr:input.url: [FILL IN THE BLANK: URL to the competition dataset]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Participants must produce benchmark scores as numerical values for Signal Quality (SQ), Ranking Consistency (RC), and Compliance Score (CS), along with binary classification labels for benchmarks like SciQ ('Accept' or 'Reject').

field.name: id
field.description: unique identifier for benchmark evaluation, e.g., benchmark_001

field.name: pred
field.description: numerical score reflecting model performance across benchmarks

cr:evaluation.notes: Total Score is computed as a weighted combination: 0.5 × SQ + 0.1 × RC + 0.4 × CS. SQ includes Monotonicity Score and Autocorrelation Strength.

open_questions: How are binary classification labels ('Accept' or 'Reject') evaluated?
